title: Doesn't fit a King bed.
text: Doesn't fit a King bed.. Not bad but not for king sized box springs. Even with A LOT of stretching, still doesn't fit all the way over my king sized box spring. Not recommended.

product_metadata.title: Biscaynebay Wrap Around Bed Skirts for Full & Full XL Beds 15 Inches Drop, Gold Elastic Dust Ruffles Easy Fit Wrinkle & Fade Resistant Silky Luxurious Fabric Solid Machine Washable
features: Stop Wresting with your Mattress! This new idea bed skirt has no platform, no need to lift the heavy mattress, simply wrap it around your bed and done. Easy to put it on and take it off. To most people, changing a bed skirt is a hard work, but this elastic bed skirt makes a hard work become so easy! Save your energy, save your time!

Special Fabric with Beautiful Ruffles: Extremely soft, silky looking fabric (not microfiber) with tiny slub make the fabric more elegant; Ruffles are made by special equipment, these ruffles are even, beautiful and lovely
Suitable for most Types of Beds: Conceals any frames, box springs, platforms, mattresses or underneath storage (But not suitable for beds with footboard or posts)

Suitable for Full beds (75"L x 54"W) and/between Full XL beds (80"L x 54"W) . Drop: 15". Special made with adjustable elastic belts so you can adjust the tensions of the bedskirts easily when necessary.
Easy care instructions: made by polyester fabric, simply machine wash. Dries quick on tumble dry low. Wrinkle and Fade Resistant, More durable than cotton.
